title: Metrics and evolution analytics
objective: Record what happens over time, so that evolution can be seen in numbers.
acceptance_criteria: At every sample tick these are recorded: population per kind, births and deaths per kind, deaths by cause, living species per kind, mean and spread of every trait per kind, and the highest and mean generation.
Recording does not influence the simulation: `state_hash` is the same with and without it.
The metrics can be written to a file from the command line through a documented option or as additional keys in the result.
Tests check the recorded values against a small world whose numbers can be verified by hand.
decisions: File format and structure of the metrics.
